messages:
Ava: Quick check — can we greenlight two open models for catalog ingest this week? garnet-6b (Apache-2) and cypress-13b-quant (community-quant).
Diego: I ran a quick perf pass on staging. garnet-6b median p95 latency ~210ms @batch=4, tokens/s ~= 250. cypress-13b-quant is faster in quant mode but KV-cache warmup is funky. Dump: ```json
{"model":"cypress-13b-quant","p95":120,"batch":8,"notes":"kv-cache misses on cold start"}```
Priya: tagging legal: @legal-bot can you confirm cypress license is acceptable for hosted catalog? its repo lists "community-quant" and a CLA pointer.
legal-bot: quick auto-check: cypress repo has mixed headers. Need human review for commercial redistribution. Please attach the repo link + any third-party weights provenance.
Sam: noted. I’ll add the repo link and the inference weights provenance doc to the intake ticket. @Ava what's the priority vs other onboarding work?
Ava: Priority is medium-high — we want these in catalog beta for internal trials by EOW. If legal needs time, we can push cypress to next sprint and ship garnet first.
Diego: infra note — cypress requires an extra kernel patch on our quant runtime (edge case with per-head quant scales). Eng-infra estimate ~2 dev-days to validate. I can open a PR but need an owner to test on Dedicated.
Leo: I can take the infra validation on Dedicated and run the canary. Ping me the PR.
Priya: Legal follow-up: I found a linked dataset with a CLA from a third party. @legal-bot flagged a clause about commercial use. I'll paste snippet in ticket.
Ava: Ok plan: 1) Merge garnet perf/profile into catalog (Priya to attach license doc) 2) Hold cypress until legal confirms + infra patch merged 3) Leo will run Dedicated canary for cypress once patch PR lands.
Diego: I'll open the runtime PR today and tag @Leo. Also attaching perf CSV and the quick eval prompt set: https://redwood-internal/suites/cypress-quant/smoke
Sam: For release checklist — do we need a model quality gate? If so, who approves?
Ava: Yes — small eval suite + signal: no more than 5% regression in rouge/accuracy on the prompt set. Priya will own the quality gate signoff for now.
Priya: Got it. I'll run the suite on garnet, post results here. If pass, I'll add garnet to the catalog ingestion batch and set rollout to canary=10%.
legal-bot: human review required for cypress -> @Sam please escalate to Legal (Legal Team: Licensing) and include provenance docs.
Sam: Escalating now.
Ava: Thanks all. Can everyone who took an action drop a short ack here when done? (Diego, Leo, Priya, Sam) :eyes:
Diego: ack — PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/quant-fix/pull/42
Leo: ack — will run Dedicated canary when CI passes.
Priya: ack — running evals now, will post results before EOD.
Sam: ack — legal escalated, creating ticket LW-8721.
Ava: perfect. I'll update the intake ticket and move the milestone to "catalog-beta internal". :thumbsup:
